artworks.title: The Rabbit Hunters
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a city in the distance, a castle on a cliff, fields, forests, and two figures with a dog hunting. There are sailboats on water and houses on farmland. The style is detailed with etching lines in sepia tones.

artworks.title: The Nursing of Jupiter
artworks.medium: graphite heightened with white on brown paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of mythological figures in a ceremonial scene. The composition features multiple figures in various poses, centered around a symbolic gathering. The drawing is detailed, providing a classical representation of human forms, draped fabrics, and an animal. A plateau with trees is subtly depicted in the background. The figures display expressions ranging from serene to contemplative.

artworks.title: The Angel Appearing to the Centurion Cornelius
artworks.artist: attributed to Cornelis Cornelisz van Haarlem
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash and white heightening on paper prepared with diluted red chalk
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 16.7 x 15 cm (6 9/16 x 5 7/8 in.)
support: 31 x 24.8 cm (12 3/16 x 9 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures engaged in an interaction. One figure is pointing their finger while the other is holding a cloak. An ethereal figure on the left resembles a winged angel and is gesturing towards the figure on the right. The figure on the right is standing confidently with a hand on their chest and draped in a classical outfit with a cloak. The scene is rendered in a monochrome style with a warm, earthy tone, using expressive lines and shading.

artworks.title: An Eastern Ruler Seated on His Throne
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on laid paper
artworks.description: A crowned, bearded man sits facing us on a throne, and he holds a sword and orb in this vertical drawing, which was made using black ink on parchment-colored paper. A three-peaked, jeweled crown nestles in a twisted turban on the man’s head. He faces us but his eyes look to our right, and he has a long, hooked nose and flowing hair and beard. A band of ornate jewels could be a collar resting over his shoulders and on his chest, or it could be that the edge of his robe is elaborately decorated. His robe has voluminous, flowing long sleeves and his garment is decorated with bands of jewels and fringe at the shoulders, hem, and down the front. His left hand, on our right, rests on a round orb about the size of an orange, and he holds the hilt of a jewel-encrusted sword upright with his other hand so the tip of the sword rests on the ground. The artist signed the work with his initials at the bottom center: “AD.”

artworks.title: The Angel of the Annunciation [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length illustration of a figure in motion. The figure is positioned diagonally across the left portion of the image, with their body slightly bent forward and head tilted downward. The facial features are softly depicted in a profile view, with slightly curly hair framing the face. The attire includes a flowing garment with voluminous sleeves and intricate details. The figure appears to be holding onto the garment. The background is a plain, neutral parchment with subtle pencil sketches and faint hand-drawn details. A faint outline of another figure is on the right side of the image.

artworks.title: Enfant Dessinant (Child Drawing)
artworks.description: The image features a young boy shown in three different positions. The central depiction shows the boy seated at a table, leaning forward as he writes or draws. To the right are two smaller sketches of the boy's face in different angles. The background includes a boat and a faint horizon line, with no other visible objects. The piece is monochrome and executed with a light touch.

artworks.title: The Hammock (Le hamac)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in a hammock hanging under a leafy tree. She is reclining with a book in her right hand. She has her eyes closed and looks relaxed, with her hair styled neatly under a feathered hat. She is wearing a long-sleeved dress with lace details. Nearby, there is a wooden stool and an open parasol on the grass. The background has more leafy branches overhead and a grassy area.

artworks.title: Bust of a Girl
artworks.medium: etching with roulette on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a head-and-shoulders portrait of a person facing forward. The facial features are emphasized with deep dark lines, including the eyes, nose, and mouth. The hair is full and somewhat messy, falling in wavy strands around the face. The person is dressed in textured clothing, possibly a light garment, created with cross-hatching techniques. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is textured and shaded to add depth to the portrait.

artworks.title: Cow Drinking
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene with animals and humans. There are rocky, wooded terrain, ruins, a stone structure covered in foliage, cows, goats, two sitting figures, a standing figure with a staff, a water body where a dog drinks, and more foliage and rocks in the distance. The artwork is a detailed black and white etching with fine lines creating textures in the stone, animals, and figures. The color palette is monochrome, highlighting the shadows and highlights of the scene.

artworks.title: Cow Pissing
artworks.description: The image shows an etching depicting a scene with goats grazing, a cow in the center, distant hills, trees, and figures resting against a tree. The composition is divided into various planes, with detailed line work used to render the animals, landscape, and figures. The color palette is primarily shades of brown, typical of etchings focused on light, dark, contrast, and linework.

artworks.title: Cow Pissing
artworks.description: The etching depicts a scene with animals and resting figures. The point of view is slightly elevated, showing the horizon low and partially obscured by a cow. Distant hills are visible to the left, with a series of trees on the right. The detailed etching technique features intricately rendered lines for textures. In the foreground, there are goats and a child, with cows and a figure resting in the background. The landscape is softly outlined, with a monochromatic color palette emphasizing line and form.

artworks.title: Herd Crossing the Brook
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene from a slightly elevated angle, with a herdsman on an ox guiding cattle and sheep through shallow water. Mountains on the left and right imply a valley or passageway. The artwork features delicate lines detailing the textures of the animals, the herdsman's clothing, and the surrounding rocks and earth. The monochromatic palette emphasizes the linear technique, creating a serene atmosphere. The animals wade through the water with their reflections, while the herdsman manages the herd with his staff. In the distance, textured lines suggest lush vegetation against rock formations.

artworks.title: Herd Crossing the Brook
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with animals and people crossing a shallow body of water. In the foreground, sheep and cattle are wading through the water with their reflections visible. A woman stands with her back to the viewer holding a child. Further back, more cattle are visible, one being ridden by a man with a wide-brimmed hat and staff. In the background, there are towering cliffs and rock formations. The artwork is done with detailed etching lines creating texture, particularly in the animals' fur and woman's clothing. The color palette is monochromatic, using different shades of black and white that emphasize the lines and shading techniques.

artworks.title: The Rest before the Inn
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with donkeys and sheep. A woman is sitting on a donkey, reaching out towards a man in a wide-brimmed hat. In the foreground, there are donkeys and sheep, creating a sense of rural life. The detailed line work and cross-hatching add depth and texture to the image. The background features a stone or rough-textured wall, and the composition is balanced with animals and figures arranged to capture a moment of everyday life in a countryside setting.

artworks.title: The Rest before the Inn
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with animals and a rider on a donkey in front of a building. It depicts a variety of animals, including donkeys, sheep, and a goat, situated around a seated figure on a donkey. The setting appears rustic, with the figures placed outside a shelter or stable where an entrance and two figures are partially visible at a window. The drawing captures detailed textures in the animals' fur, foliage, and shading. The composition emphasizes a tranquil, pastoral life with the rider apparently conversing with the figures at the window. The cross-hatching technique gives depth and dimension to the artwork, highlighting attention to detail in outlining and texture.

artworks.title: Resting Herd
artworks.description: The image is portrayed from an elevated point of view, showing a pastoral scene. The horizon line is high, with the sky in the upper left. Trees and a shepherd with a wide-brimmed hat are on the right, close to the horizon. Delicate pencil lines define various elements like animal fur and tree bark. The overall color palette is soft grays and white. Animals, including horses, cows, goats, and sheep, are in a meadow. The terrain rises in the distance, creating depth.

artworks.title: Resting Herd
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a pastoral scene with livestock and a shepherd. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, showing animals resting and grazing in a natural setting. The horizon is high, with low hills, sparse trees, and a sky filled with clouds. The etching style features intricate linework depicting textures of fur, grass, and foliage. Animals, including cows, horses, and a sheep, are shown close by, with a shepherd and a goat standing nearby. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black and white.

artworks.title: The Shepherd Seated on a Fountain and the Spinner
artworks.description: This is a drawing of livestock and objects in a pastoral setting. The drawing depicts a rural scene with a person playing a flute while sitting on a stone bench under a tree. The foreground features animals such as a cow, a group of sheep, and a dog. The background includes architectural features and tree bark textures. The lines suggest a peaceful atmosphere, capturing the interaction between nature and human-made structures.

artworks.title: The Shepherd Seated on a Fountain and the Spinner
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with animals and two figures. It shows a serene rural setting with a variety of farm animals including a cow, sheep, and a dog surrounding a stone structure. One figure plays a flute on the structure while another figure stands nearby holding a staff. The background includes intricate line work suggesting architectural details of the stone structure and shadowed areas hinting at trees or foliage. The composition creates a tranquil atmosphere reminiscent of rustic life.

artworks.title: Shepherdess on a Donkey
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic scene with two figures seated on animals near a body of water. The man stands on the left holding a paper, and the woman sits on a donkey on the right. Various animals are depicted in detailed linework with fine lines and cross-hatching. The landscape ascends to distant hills with a faint structure, and the horizon is delineated by the rising hills against the sky. The palette is monochromatic in shades of grey and black, giving a classic, timeless feel to the rural scene.

artworks.title: Shepherdess on a Donkey
artworks.description: The image displays a pastoral scene with animals and people around a body of water. A man stands behind a horse, a woman sits on a donkey reaching out, and other animals like a dog, sheep, cow, and another donkey are nearby. In the distance, more figures are shown walking on a path, with mountains in the background. The etching technique uses fine lines and cross-hatching for a textured look. The color scheme is a sepia tone.

artworks.title: Eagles
artworks.description: This shows a drawing of vultures feeding on a carcass. Three vultures are eating the remains of an animal on the ground. One vulture is spreading its wings, one is pecking at the carcass, and another is observing from a rock. The background features textured, cloudy skies and rough terrain. The artist used fine lines and shading to depict detail and texture in the birds and landscape, aiming for a naturalistic representation of a feeding scene.

artworks.title: The Kneeling Hermit Facing Left
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a kneeling position, holding an object in their hands. The person is dressed in a long robe and the background features rocky terrain with foliage.

artworks.title: The Kneeling Hermit Facing Right
artworks.description: The image shows a person kneeling on the ground, with their hands clasped together in front of them. The person has shoulder-length hair and facial hair, wearing a robe with a waist cord. A rosary hangs from their waist. In front of them, a tree trunk with a crucifix attached is visible, along with a skull resting on a book. The background shows trees and clouds, suggesting an outdoor setting in an aged historical style.
